title: @dogtrax or if a poet knows where a poem goes maybe its no poem for no one to know #smallpoems
summary: @dogtrax or if a poet knows where a poem goes maybe its no poem for no one to know #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
@dogtrax or
if a poet
knows
where a poem
goes
maybe its
no poem
for no one
to know
#smallpoems
